cohort: 27 women who underwent open fetal myelomeningocele closure surgery at the Ontario Fetal Centre
finding: Fetal open spina bifida closure in Canada resulted in comparable outcomes to international centers, with some maternal complications and infant deaths reported, requiring further long-term follow-up.
mod_finding: All but one patient delivered by cesarean section.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at surgery was 25.0 ± 0.7 weeks. Mean gestational age at delivery was 34.9±3.0 weeks.
